title: AprilNEA/OpenLogi
claim: AprilNEA/OpenLogi — ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HI
why_good: OpenLogi is a Rust-based desktop app and agent that talks to Logitech HID++ peripherals over Bolt, Unifying, Bluetooth, or USB. It remaps buttons, adjusts DPI, toggles SmartShift, and switches profiles per app, with a GUI, CLI, and plain TOML config.
value: Privacy-conscious Logitech users on Linux or Windows pay for a hassle-free installer and ongoing support to get full mouse control without Options+.
risk: Logitech could add Linux support or gesture-button remapping to Options+, making OpenLogi redundant for most users.
does: OpenLogi is a Rust-based desktop app and agent that talks to Logitech HID++ peripherals over Bolt, Unifying, Bluetooth, or USB. It remaps buttons, adjusts DPI, toggles SmartShift, and switches profiles per app, with a GUI, CLI, and plain TOML config.
why_use: Unlike Options+, OpenLogi runs on Linux, lets you move the gesture button, keeps config in plain text, and is scriptable via CLI—all without telemetry or an account.
gap: Logitech Options+ is proprietary and limited to Windows/macOS, leaving Linux and advanced users without a native, local-first alternative.
counter: Logitech owns the protocol and could squash this with a single Options+ update that adds Linux support or gesture-button customization. Also, it's a niche tool for a shrinking audience as Logitech moves to subscription models.
differentiator: Package OpenLogi as a one-click installer with a friendly GUI and Chinese localization, targeting the underserved Linux and privacy-conscious Logitech users in China.
hook: Logitech mouse owners on Linux or those who hate Options+'s bloat and account requirement are stuck with limited remapping or proprietary software.

zh.claim: OpenLogi 是一个原生、本地优先的 Logitech Options+ 替代品，通过 HID++ 重映射按钮、DPI 和 SmartShift，无需账户或遥测。
zh.hook: Linux 上的罗技鼠标用户，或讨厌 Options+ 臃肿和账户要求的人，受限于有限的重新映射或专有软件。
zh.does: OpenLogi 是一个基于 Rust 的桌面应用和代理，通过 Bolt、Unifying、蓝牙或 USB 与罗技 HID++ 外设通信。它可以重映射按钮、调整 DPI、切换 SmartShift，并按应用切换配置文件，提供 GUI、CLI 和纯 TOML 配置。
zh.why_use: 与 Options+ 不同，OpenLogi 支持 Linux，允许移动手势按钮，将配置保存在纯文本中，并可通过 CLI 编写脚本——所有这些都没有遥测或账户。
zh.gap: 只有极客才能使用：它是一个原始的 GitHub 项目，没有完善的安装程序或支持，中国市场案例为空——没有本地化文档或社区。
zh.counter: 罗技拥有该协议，并可能通过一次 Options+ 更新（添加 Linux 支持或手势按钮自定义）来扼杀它。此外，这是一个小众工具，随着罗技转向订阅模式，受众正在萎缩。
zh.differentiator: 将 OpenLogi 打包为一键安装程序，提供友好的 GUI 和中文本地化，瞄准中国 underserved 的 Linux 和隐私意识强的罗技用户。
zh.value: 隐私意识强的罗技用户（Linux 或 Windows）付费获得无忧安装程序和持续支持，以在无需 Options+ 的情况下获得完整的鼠标控制。
zh.risk: 罗技可能会在 Options+ 中添加 Linux 支持或手势按钮重新映射，使 OpenLogi 对大多数用户变得多余。
zh.why_good: OpenLogi 是一个基于 Rust 的桌面应用和代理，通过 Bolt、Unifying、蓝牙或 USB 与罗技 HID++ 外设通信。它可以重映射按钮、调整 DPI、切换 SmartShift，并按应用切换配置文件，提供 GUI、CLI 和纯 TOML 配置。

consumer_angle: Ordinary users who want to customize their Logitech peripherals without vendor lock-in or cloud dependency.
pick_reason: Strong community activity and clear pain, but the gap is niche (Linux/advanced users) and the wedge is not yet a polished consumer product.
